title: Chip startup Nova Spectral AI raises Rs 21 crore to build low-cost image sensors
summary: Chip startup Nova Spectral AI raises 21 crore rupees to build low-cost image sensors
detailed: Founded by IIT Kanpur alumni Anish Priyadarshi and Sanjeev Kumar, the startup is developing a short-wave infrared (SWIR) sensor that can help cameras capture images in low light and through smoke, haze, and fog. It aims to make these sensors up to 100 times cheaper than existing technology, opening
